svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Rounded', 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: HyperMe motion options: the dot and the voice animation (animated)
svg.text: The dot at rest (state: something waits for you)
A. Ring
A still dark dot. A violet ring
appears when something waits.
No motion at all.
B. Glass that breathes · recommended
A small glass bead. When something
waits, a violet halo breathes slowly.
Still the rest of the time.
C. Sleeping voice
A tiny capsule with three resting bars,
the same bars that wake up as you talk.
They stir faintly when something waits.
The pill while you talk (the motion follows your voice)
1. Level bars
The familiar meter. Clear, but it is
what Wispr Flow and most dictation
apps show.
2. Voice ribbon · recommended
Two soft lines that swell with your
voice and flow sideways, white over
violet. Calm when you pause.
3. Rolling trace
Your voice scrolls past like a
recording; pauses show as gaps.
Busier to look at.
After you let go: working
The line goes flat and a light runs along it · recommended
Continues the ribbon; usually visible for under half a second. The alternative is three soft dots.
Open this file in a browser to see the motion. Mockups only; the real pill draws at 30 frames a second only while visible.
